# POST /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/comments/{id}/reactions

Add a reaction to a comment of an issue

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** token · **ID:** `ep-301`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |
| id | path | integer (int64) | True |

**Request Body** (`application/json`) — `api.EditReactionOption`

| Field | Type | Required | Validation |
|-------|------|----------|------------|
| `content` | string | True | must be in setting.UI.ReactionsLookup |

## Response

**201** — api.Reaction

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `user` | api.User | The user who created the reaction |
| `content` | string | The reaction type/emoji |
| `created_at` | time.Time | When the reaction was created |

- **200** — reaction already exists (returns existing)
- **403** — forbidden reaction type, blocked user, or locked issue without write permission
- **404** — comment not found or belongs to different repo

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Comment must belong to the same repository | validation | comment.Issue.RepoID != ctx.Repo.Repository.ID |
| Cannot add/remove reaction on locked issue without write permission | authorization | comment.Issue.IsLocked && !ctx.Repo.Permission.CanWriteIssuesOrPulls(comment.Issue.IsPull) |
| Reaction type must be in the allowed reactions list | validation | !setting.UI.ReactionsLookup.Contains(opts.Type) |
| If reaction already exists, return existing reaction with 200 instead of error | business_logic | issues_model.IsErrReactionAlreadyExist(err) |
| Blocked users cannot create reactions | authorization | user_model.IsUserBlockedBy(ctx, doer, comment.Issue.PosterID, comment.Issue.Repo.OwnerID, comment.PosterID) |
| Admin users bypass block checks | authorization | blockee.IsAdmin |

## Error Handling

| Trigger | Status | Response | Retryable |
|---------|--------|----------|-----------|
| reaction type not in allowed list | 403 | forbidden | False |
| duplicate reaction | 200 | existing reaction returned | False |
| doer is blocked by poster/owner | 403 | forbidden | False |

### Error Paths

- **comment not found** → changeIssueCommentReaction → 404
- **comment belongs to different repo** → changeIssueCommentReaction → 404
- **no read permission** → changeIssueCommentReaction → 404
- **issue locked and no write permission** → changeIssueCommentReaction → 403
- **forbidden reaction type** → changeIssueCommentReaction → 403
- **user blocked** → changeIssueCommentReaction → 403
- **reaction already exists** → changeIssueCommentReaction → 200
